Thanks Laura — really appreciate the offer and enjoyed meeting the team. Quick heads-up: I received a competing offer from Nimbus Analytics with a 175,000 USD base and similar equity. They've given me a firm sign-by of 2026-02-12 COB. I prefer Redwood on culture and product, but the base difference is material.

Would Redwood be willing to adjust base or sign-on to be competitive? If there’s room for a counter, I can try to delay the Nimbus deadline, but it’s not guaranteed. Ideally looking for 172,000 base or equivalent sign-on to bridge the gap.
